feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 12:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later, gales in places.


##Synopsis##

Very weak ridge of high pressure at first will decline, deep low pressure will move eastwards through the English Channel tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, gradually backing South or Southwest through this afternoon. Further backing and increasing East 5 or 6 this evening, then North or Northeast 5 to 7 tonight. Backing North or Northwest 6 to gale 8 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough later today and tonight.


##Weather##

Fair, then heavy rain tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 7 or gale 8, decreasing West or Northwest 5 to 7 tomorrow evening. Backing West or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday, increasing South 7 to severe gale 9 Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling moderate overnight into Saturday, building rough or very rough by late Saturday morning.


##Weather##

Rain at first and later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, otherwise good.
